12	
13	# Rational maps between schemes
14	
15	## Main definitions
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap`: A partial map from `X` to `Y` (`X.PartialMap Y`) is
18	  a morphism into `Y` defined on a dense open subscheme of `X`.
19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.equiv`:
20	  Two partial maps are equivalent if they are equal on a dense open subscheme.
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap`:
22	  A rational map from `X` to `Y` (`X ⤏ Y`) is an equivalence class of partial maps.
23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.equivFunctionFieldOver`:
24	  Given `S`-schemes `X` and `Y` such that `Y` is locally of finite type and `X` is integral,
25	  `S`-morphisms `Spec K(X) ⟶ Y` correspond bijectively to `S`-rational maps from `X` to `Y`.
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.toPartialMap`:
27	  If `X` is reduced and `Y` is separated, then any `f : X ⤏ Y` can be realized as a partial
28	  map on `f.domain`, the domain of definition of `f`.
29	-/

43	/--
44	A partial map from `X` to `Y` (`X.PartialMap Y`) is a morphism into `Y`
45	defined on a dense open subscheme of `X`.
46	-/
47	structure PartialMap (X Y : Scheme.{u}) where
48	  /-- The domain of definition of a partial map. -/
49	  domain : X.Opens
50	  dense_domain : Dense (domain : Set X)
51	  /-- The underlying morphism of a partial map. -/
52	  hom : ↑domain ⟶ Y
53	
54	variable (S) in
55	/-- A partial map is an `S`-map if the underlying morphism is. -/
56	abbrev PartialMap.IsOver [X.Over S] [Y.Over S] (f : X.PartialMap Y) :=
57	  f.hom.IsOver S

61	lemma ext_iff (f g : X.PartialMap Y) :
62	    f = g ↔ ∃ e : f.domain = g.domain, f.hom = (X.isoOfEq e).hom ≫ g.hom := by
63	  constructor
64	  · rintro rfl
65	    simp
66	  · obtain ⟨U, hU, f⟩ := f
67	    obtain ⟨V, hV, g⟩ := g
68	    rintro ⟨rfl : U = V, e⟩
69	    congr 1
70	    simpa using e
71	
72	@[ext]
73	lemma ext (f g : X.PartialMap Y) (e : f.domain = g.domain)
74	    (H : f.hom = (X.isoOfEq e).hom ≫ g.hom) : f = g := by
75	  rw [ext_iff]
76	  exact ⟨e, H⟩

83	  domain := U
84	  dense_domain := hU
85	  hom := X.homOfLE hU' ≫ f.hom

161	    (f.restrict U hU hU').fromSpecStalkOfMem hx = f.fromSpecStalkOfMem (hU' hx) := by

181	/--
182	Given `S`-schemes `X` and `Y` such that `Y` is locally of finite type and
183	`X` is irreducible germ-injective at `x` (e.g. when `X` is integral),
184	any `S`-morphism `Spec 𝒪ₓ ⟶ Y` spreads out to a partial map from `X` to `Y`.
185	-/
186	noncomputable
187	def ofFromSpecStalk [IrreducibleSpace X] [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] {x : X} [X.IsGermInjectiveAt x]
188	    (φ : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) ⟶ Y) (h : φ ≫ sY = X.fromSpecStalk x ≫ sX) : X.PartialMap Y where
189	  hom := (spread_out_of_isGermInjective' sX sY φ h).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose
190	  domain := (spread_out_of_isGermInjective' sX sY φ h).choose
191	  dense_domain := (spread_out_of_isGermInjective' sX sY φ h).choose.2.dense
192	    ⟨_, (spread_out_of_isGermInjective' sX sY φ h).choose_spec.choose⟩

196	    (h : φ ≫ sY = X.fromSpecStalk x ≫ sX) :
197	    (ofFromSpecStalk sX sY φ h).hom ≫ sY = (ofFromSpecStalk sX sY φ h).domain.ι ≫ sX :=
198	  (spread_out_of_isGermInjective' sX sY φ h).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec.2

202	    (h : φ ≫ sY = X.fromSpecStalk x ≫ sX) : x ∈ (ofFromSpecStalk sX sY φ h).domain :=

223	/-- Two partial maps are equivalent if they are equal on a dense open subscheme. -/
224	protected noncomputable
225	def equiv (f g : X.PartialMap Y) : Prop :=
226	  ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hW : Dense (W : Set X)) (hWl : W ≤ f.domain) (hWr : W ≤ g.domain),
227	    (f.restrict W hW hWl).hom = (g.restrict W hW hWr).hom

229	set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
230	lemma equivalence_rel : Equivalence (@Scheme.PartialMap.equiv X Y) where
231	  refl f := ⟨f.domain, f.dense_domain, by simp⟩
232	  symm {f g} := by
233	    intro ⟨W, hW, hWl, hWr, e⟩
234	    exact ⟨W, hW, hWr, hWl, e.symm⟩
235	  trans {f g h} := by
236	    intro ⟨W₁, hW₁, hW₁l, hW₁r, e₁⟩ ⟨W₂, hW₂, hW₂l, hW₂r, e₂⟩
237	    refine ⟨W₁ ⊓ W₂, hW₁.inter_of_isOpen_left hW₂ W₁.2, inf_le_left.trans hW₁l,
238	      inf_le_right.trans hW₂r, ?_⟩
239	    dsimp at e₁ e₂
240	    simp only [restrict_domain, restrict_hom, ← X.homOfLE_homOfLE (U := W₁ ⊓ W₂) inf_le_left hW₁l,
241	      Category.assoc, e₁, ← X.homOfLE_homOfLE (U := W₁ ⊓ W₂) inf_le_right hW₂r, ← e₂]
242	    simp only [homOfLE_homOfLE_assoc]
243	
244	instance : Setoid (X.PartialMap Y) := ⟨@PartialMap.equiv X Y, equivalence_rel⟩

247	lemma restrict_equiv (f : X.PartialMap Y) (U : X.Opens)
248	    (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) (hU' : U ≤ f.domain) : (f.restrict U hU hU').equiv f :=

253	lemma equiv_of_fromSpecStalkOfMem_eq [IrreducibleSpace X]
254	    {x : X} [X.IsGermInjectiveAt x] (f g : X.PartialMap Y)
255	    (hxf : x ∈ f.domain) (hxg : x ∈ g.domain)
256	    (H : f.fromSpecStalkOfMem hxf = g.fromSpecStalkOfMem hxg) : f.equiv g := by
257	  have hdense : Dense ((f.domain ⊓ g.domain) : Set X) :=
258	    f.dense_domain.inter_of_isOpen_left g.dense_domain f.domain.2
259	  have := (isGermInjectiveAt_iff_of_isOpenImmersion (f := (f.domain ⊓ g.domain).ι)
260	    (x := ⟨x, hxf, hxg⟩)).mp ‹_›
261	  have := spread_out_unique_of_isGermInjective' (X := (f.domain ⊓ g.domain).toScheme)
262	    (X.homOfLE inf_le_left ≫ f.hom) (X.homOfLE inf_le_right ≫ g.hom) (x := ⟨x, hxf, hxg⟩) ?_
263	  · obtain ⟨U, hxU, e⟩ := this
264	    refine ⟨(f.domain ⊓ g.domain).ι ''ᵁ U, ((f.domain ⊓ g.domain).ι ''ᵁ U).2.dense
265	      ⟨_, ⟨_, hxU, rfl⟩⟩,
266	      ((Set.image_subset_range _ _).trans_eq (Subtype.range_val)).trans inf_le_left,
267	      ((Set.image_subset_range _ _).trans_eq (Subtype.range_val)).trans inf_le_right, ?_⟩
268	    rw [← cancel_epi (Scheme.Hom.isoImage _ _).hom]
269	    simp only [restrict_hom, ← Category.assoc] at e ⊢
270	    convert! e using 2 <;> rw [← cancel_mono (Scheme.Opens.ι _)] <;> simp
271	  · rw [← f.fromSpecStalkOfMem_restrict hdense inf_le_left ⟨hxf, hxg⟩,
272	      ← g.fromSpecStalkOfMem_restrict hdense inf_le_right ⟨hxf, hxg⟩] at H
273	    simpa only [fromSpecStalkOfMem, restrict_domain, Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem, Spec.map_inv,
274	      restrict_hom, Category.assoc, IsIso.eq_inv_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc] using H

277	/-- Two partial maps from reduced schemes to separated schemes are equivalent if and only if
278	they are equal on **any** open dense subset. -/
279	lemma equiv_iff_of_isSeparated_of_le [X.Over S] [Y.Over S] [IsReduced X]
280	    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ S)] {f g : X.PartialMap Y} [f.IsOver S] [g.IsOver S]
281	    {W : X.Opens} (hW : Dense (X := X) W) (hWl : W ≤ f.domain) (hWr : W ≤ g.domain) : f.equiv g ↔
282	      (f.restrict W hW hWl).hom = (g.restrict W hW hWr).hom := by
283	  refine ⟨fun ⟨V, hV, hVl, hVr, e⟩ ↦ ?_, fun e ↦ ⟨_, _, _, _, e⟩⟩
284	  have : IsDominant (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ≤ W)) :=
285	    Opens.isDominant_homOfLE (hW.inter_of_isOpen_left hV W.2) _
286	  apply ext_of_isDominant_of_isSeparated' S (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ≤ W))
287	  simpa using congr(X.homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ≤ V) ≫ $e)

289	/-- Two partial maps from reduced schemes to separated schemes are equivalent if and only if
290	they are equal on the intersection of the domains. -/
291	lemma equiv_iff_of_isSeparated [X.Over S] [Y.Over S] [IsReduced X]
292	    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ S)] {f g : X.PartialMap Y}
293	    [f.IsOver S] [g.IsOver S] : f.equiv g ↔
294	      (f.restrict _ (f.2.inter_of_isOpen_left g.2 f.domain.2) inf_le_left).hom =
295	      (g.restrict _ (f.2.inter_of_isOpen_left g.2 f.domain.2) inf_le_right).hom :=
296	  equiv_iff_of_isSeparated_of_le (S := S) _ _ _

299	/-- Two partial maps from reduced schemes to separated schemes with the same domain are equivalent
300	if and only if they are equal. -/
301	lemma equiv_iff_of_domain_eq_of_isSeparated [X.Over S] [Y.Over S] [IsReduced X]
302	    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ S)] {f g : X.PartialMap Y} (hfg : f.domain = g.domain)
303	    [f.IsOver S] [g.IsOver S] : f.equiv g ↔ f = g := by
304	  rw [equiv_iff_of_isSeparated_of_le (S := S) f.dense_domain le_rfl hfg.le]
305	  obtain ⟨Uf, _, f⟩ := f
306	  obtain ⟨Ug, _, g⟩ := g
307	  obtain rfl : Uf = Ug := hfg

311	/-- A partial map from a reduced scheme to a separated scheme is equivalent to a morphism

313	lemma equiv_toPartialMap_iff_of_isSeparated [X.Over S] [Y.Over S] [IsReduced X]

316	      f.hom = f.domain.ι ≫ g := by
317	  rw [equiv_iff_of_isSeparated (S := S), ← cancel_epi (X.isoOfEq (inf_top_eq f.domain)).hom]

323	/-- A rational map from `X` to `Y` (`X ⤏ Y`) is an equivalence class of partial maps,
324	where two partial maps are equivalent if they are equal on a dense open subscheme. -/
325	def RationalMap (X Y : Scheme.{u}) : Type u :=
326	  @Quotient (X.PartialMap Y) inferInstance

328	/-- The notation for rational maps. -/

332	def PartialMap.toRationalMap (f : X.PartialMap Y) : X ⤏ Y := Quotient.mk _ f

6	import Mathlib

8	/-!
9	# Pairing of two rational maps into a fibre product
10	
11	Mathlib's `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap` API provides `compHom`
12	(right-composition with a morphism) but no way to *pair* two rational maps out of
13	a common source into a fibre product. For Milne's difference-map construction
14	`Φ = m ∘ (f × f) : X × X ⤏ G` (Milne, *Abelian Varieties*, Lemma 3.3) one needs
15	exactly this pairing: given `f ∘ pr₁` and `f ∘ pr₂ : X × X ⤏ G`, assemble the map
16	`X × X ⤏ G ×_{k̄} G` whose two projections recover the factors, so that it can be
17	right-composed with the group law `G ×_{k̄} G → G`.
18	
19	The naive `PartialMap`-level pairing via `pullback.lift` does **not** descend to
20	rational maps through `Quotient.map₂`: `RationalMap.IsOver S` guarantees only *one*
21	over-`S` representative, not that an arbitrary pair of representatives is
22	simultaneously over `S`, so the compatibility hypothesis fails. Instead we use the
23	function-field correspondence: over an integral source `X`, a rational map
24	`X ⤏ Y` over `S` is the same datum as an `S`-morphism `Spec K(X) ⟶ Y`
25	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.ofFunctionField` /
26	`equivFunctionField`), and morphisms out of the single scheme `Spec K(X)` pair
27	freely by `pullback.lift`.
28	
29	To stay clear of `Over`-typeclass diamonds on the pullback target we work with
30	explicit structure morphisms `sX : X ⟶ S`, `sY : Y ⟶ S`, `sZ : Z ⟶ S` (matching
31	mathlib's `equivFunctionField`), and phrase the over-`S` datum as the equation
32	`a.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap`. In Milne's setting `S = Spec k̄`,
33	`sX = X.hom`, `sY = sZ = G.hom`, and the target `pullback G.hom G.hom` is
34	definitionally `(G ⊗ G).left` (`CategoryTheory.Over.tensorObj_left`), so the group
35	law `(GrpObj.mul).left : (G ⊗ G).left ⟶ G.left` composes on the right directly.
36	
37	## Main definitions
38	
39	* `Scheme.RationalMap.prod` — the pairing `X ⤏ pullback sY sZ` of `a : X ⤏ Y` and
40	  `b : X ⤏ Z`, both over `S`.
41	
42	## Main results
43	
44	* `Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_compHom` — the function-field morphism of a
45	  right-composition is the composite of function-field morphisms.
46	* `Scheme.RationalMap.prod_compHom_fst` / `prod_compHom_snd` — the two projections of
47	  the pairing recover the original rational maps.
48	* `Scheme.RationalMap.prod_compHom_over` — the pairing is again over `S`.
49	-/
50	
51	set_option autoImplicit false
52	
53	universe u
54	
55	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace
56	
57	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
58	
59	namespace Scheme
60	
61	namespace RationalMap
62	
63	variable {T X Y Z S : Scheme.{u}}
64	
65	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
66	/-- **Associativity of right-composition.** Composing on the right by `g` and then `h`
67	is composing by `g ≫ h`. -/
68	@[simp]
69	lemma compHom_compHom (f : X ⤏ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ T) :
70	    (f.compHom g).compHom h = f.compHom (g ≫ h) := by
71	  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := f.exists_rep
72	  simp only [← compHom_toRationalMap]
73	  refine congrArg PartialMap.toRationalMap (PartialMap.ext _ _ rfl ?_)
74	  simp only [PartialMap.compHom_hom, Scheme.isoOfEq_rfl, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp,
75	    Category.assoc]
76	
77	/-- **Function-field functoriality of right-composition.** For a rational map
78	`f : X ⤏ Y` out of an irreducible scheme and a morphism `g : Y ⟶ Z`, the associated
79	morphism `Spec K(X) ⟶ Z` of `f.compHom g` is `f.fromFunctionField ≫ g`. -/
80	@[simp]
81	lemma fromFunctionField_compHom [IrreducibleSpace X] (f : X ⤏ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
82	    (f.compHom g).fromFunctionField = f.fromFunctionField ≫ g := by
83	  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := f.exists_rep
84	  rw [← compHom_toRationalMap, fromFunctionField_toRationalMap, fromFunctionField_toRationalMap]
85	  exact PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem_compHom f g _ _
86	
87	/-- The function-field morphism of an over-`S` rational map factors the structure
88	morphism: if `a.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap`, then
89	`a.fromFunctionField ≫ sY = X.fromSpecStalk η ≫ sX`. -/
90	lemma fromFunctionField_comp_structure [IsIntegral X] (a : X ⤏ Y) (sX : X ⟶ S)
91	    (sY : Y ⟶ S) (ha : a.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap) :
92	    a.fromFunctionField ≫ sY = X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ sX := by
93	  rw [← fromFunctionField_compHom, ha]
94	  exact PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem_toPartialMap sX _
95	
96	/-- **Pairing of two rational maps into a fibre product.** For rational maps
97	`a : X ⤏ Y` and `b : X ⤏ Z` out of an integral scheme `X`, both defined over `S`
98	(encoded as `a.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap`, resp. for `b`), the pairing
99	`a.prod b : X ⤏ pullback sY sZ` is the rational map whose function-field morphism is
100	`pullback.lift a.fromFunctionField b.fromFunctionField`.
101	
102	Milne's difference map is `(f.precomp pr₁).prod (f.precomp pr₂)` followed by
103	right-composition with the group law of `G`. -/
104	noncomputable def prod (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S) (sZ : Z ⟶ S)
105	    [IsIntegral X] [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ]
106	    (a : X ⤏ Y) (b : X ⤏ Z)
107	    (ha : a.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap) (hb : b.compHom sZ = sX.toRationalMap) :
108	    X ⤏ pullback sY sZ :=
109	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst sY sZ ≫ sY) :=
110	    MorphismProperty.comp_mem _ _ _ inferInstance inferInstance
111	  ofFunctionField sX (pullback.fst sY sZ ≫ sY)
112	    (pullback.lift a.fromFunctionField b.fromFunctionField
113	      ((fromFunctionField_comp_structure a sX sY ha).trans
114	        (fromFunctionField_comp_structure b sX sZ hb).symm))
115	    (by rw [pullback.lift_fst_assoc]; exact fromFunctionField_comp_structure a sX sY ha)
116	
117	/-- The function-field morphism of the pairing is the `pullback.lift` of the factors'
118	function-field morphisms. -/
119	@[simp]
120	lemma prod_fromFunctionField (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S) (sZ : Z ⟶ S)
121	    [IsIntegral X] [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ]
122	    (a : X ⤏ Y) (b : X ⤏ Z)
123	    (ha : a.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap) (hb : b.compHom sZ = sX.toRationalMap) :
124	    (prod sX sY sZ a b ha hb).fromFunctionField
125	      = pullback.lift a.fromFunctionField b.fromFunctionField
126	        ((fromFunctionField_comp_structure a sX sY ha).trans
127	          (fromFunctionField_comp_structure b sX sZ hb).symm) := by
128	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst sY sZ ≫ sY) :=
129	    MorphismProperty.comp_mem _ _ _ inferInstance inferInstance
130	  exact fromFunctionField_ofFunctionField _ _ _ _
131	
132	/-- **First projection of the pairing.** Right-composing the pairing with
133	`pullback.fst` recovers `a`. -/
134	lemma prod_compHom_fst (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S) (sZ : Z ⟶ S)
135	    [IsIntegral X] [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ]
136	    (a : X ⤏ Y) (b : X ⤏ Z)
137	    (ha : a.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap) (hb : b.compHom sZ = sX.toRationalMap) :
138	    (prod sX sY sZ a b ha hb).compHom (pullback.fst sY sZ) = a :=
139	  eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq _ _ (by
140	    rw [fromFunctionField_compHom, prod_fromFunctionField, pullback.lift_fst])
141	
142	/-- **Second projection of the pairing.** Right-composing the pairing with
143	`pullback.snd` recovers `b`. -/
144	lemma prod_compHom_snd (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S) (sZ : Z ⟶ S)
145	    [IsIntegral X] [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ]
146	    (a : X ⤏ Y) (b : X ⤏ Z)
147	    (ha : a.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap) (hb : b.compHom sZ = sX.toRationalMap) :
148	    (prod sX sY sZ a b ha hb).compHom (pullback.snd sY sZ) = b :=
149	  eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq _ _ (by
150	    rw [fromFunctionField_compHom, prod_fromFunctionField, pullback.lift_snd])
151	
152	/-- **The pairing is over `S`.** Right-composing with the structure morphism
153	`pullback.fst sY sZ ≫ sY` of the fibre product recovers `sX.toRationalMap`. -/
154	lemma prod_compHom_over (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S) (sZ : Z ⟶ S)

13	(`f : X ⤏ Y`, `g : Y ⟶ Z` ↦ `X ⤏ Z`). The dual operation — precomposing a
